config.notes: Toi Ohomai course pages (www.toiohomai.ac.nz/study/course/<slug>) refuse a plain fetch (403) and are read through Firecrawl (page_view render, no suffix). The international student view is a location setting kept by the site (button at the top right, "You're viewing this page as a New Zealand citizen or resident"); no address variant shows it, so course pages are stored in the NZ/Australian (domestic) view and carry only domestic indicative fees. International tuition fees and the next intake per course are on the central list https://www.toiohomai.ac.nz/study/international-courses-list (attached as a central page; figures "per year" for degrees and Level 6 diplomas, otherwise the programme fee). Start dates: "Course Locations and Intake Information" table (Location Campus Start Date ...). IELTS: first figure after "English Language Requirements". Delivery (mode): the campus names in the intake table (Online / Distance = online; a campus = on campus). Duration: "Study options ... Total credits N" (1 year full-time = 120 credits). Key dates: https://www.toiohomai.ac.nz/study/important-dates (2027: Semester 1 starts 22 Feb, Semester 2 starts 19 Jul). English guidance: https://www.toiohomai.ac.nz/study/get-help-english (refers to NZQA rules). Entry requirement (5 Oct 15:22): not read. Course pages are stored in the domestic view; the Entry Criteria section shows domestic criteria or the notice "To see the information for international students change your location", so no international entry requirement can be read; patterns.entry_requirement is not set. Exit awards and whole-course fees: no exit-award wording found; the only whole-course figures are domestic "Indicative Fees $X for domestic students", which are not used.
